test_title: PYST 56: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 09 Sept, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: Jwalith starts from Point Y and drives 25 km towards south. He then takes a left turn, drives 10 km. He then turns left and drives 25 km. He takes a final left turn, drives 7 km and stops at Point Z. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach Point Y again? (All turns are 90-degree turns only unless specified)
